classification_rationale: The customer disputes a damage charge on a plate compactor as normal wear and asks for it to be waived, again a waiver matter policy already covers.

draft.reply_body:
Hi,

Thanks for the message. Damage charges are worked out against our repair-cost schedule, and once they've been assessed and sent to you, they're final under our policy - we're not able to waive or renegotiate them after the fact, so the 220 EUR charge on booking RB-20265862 stands.

If you think the wear was there before the compactor went out, let us know and we'll check it against our check-out photos and inspection record.

On the generator - the unit is still flagged and out of use as agreed, and our service team will be in touch about inspecting or collecting it. Please do keep it disconnected until then, and let us know if there's any update on how your colleague is doing.

Best regards,
Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy
